en.headline: MTR probes two Lam Tin disruptions within 15 hours
en.dek: The operator apologised after a trackside fire and overheating wires forced service skips and suspensions; the government ordered a report within a month.
body: The MTR Corporation said it is investigating two successive rush-hour disruptions at Lam Tin station on the Kwun Tong Line within about 15 hours, after apologising for the inconvenience.

On Tuesday evening an insulating component on a track switch near the station caught fire, suspending services between Kwun Tong and Tiu Keng Leng for about an hour. The following morning, wires overheated in an electrical room on the platform, causing trains to skip Lam Tin for roughly an hour.

MTR officials said inspectors would examine whether the incidents are linked, including possible equipment overheating or operational factors, and would invite independent experts. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the government was highly concerned and instructed the operator to submit a comprehensive report within a month, covering maintenance procedures and system security.
No injuries were reported in either incident. The operator said it would discuss compensation arrangements with the government.

zh.headline: 港鐵調查藍田站15小時內兩宗故障 政府要求一個月內交報告
zh.dek: 周二晚軌旁絕緣部件起火及周三早月台電房電線過熱，先後影響繁忙時間服務；運輸及物流局局長要求徹底調查並提交報告。
body: 港鐵公司表示正調查觀塘綫藍田站在約15小時內接連發生的兩宗繁忙時間故障，並就造成的不便致歉。
周二傍晚，藍田站附近道岔的絕緣部件起火，導致觀塘至調景嶺服務中斷約一小時。翌日早上，月台電氣房內電線過熱冒煙，列車需跳過藍田站約一小時。
港鐵工程人員指會從設備過熱、運作程序等多角度深入調查兩宗事故是否有關連，並邀請獨立專家參與。運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示政府高度關注，已指示港鐵在一個月內提交全面報告，檢視維修程序及系統安全。
兩宗事故均無人受傷。港鐵表示會與政府商討補償安排。
